name: No-Clashing/Antichain Separation Class
definition: On the three-coordinate domain $\{x_0,x_1,x_2\}$, let $\mathcal C_{\mathrm{NC/AN}}=\{000,001,010,011,100,101\}$, where strings list values in coordinate order.
comments: A six-concept finite class witnessing that no-clashing teaching dimension can exceed the antichain number.
